notes.title: GRAND MOUNTAIN ADVENTURE: WONDERLANDS SHOWS OFF ITS GAMEPLAY IN A NEW TRAILER
notes.notes:
[b]Microids Indie[/b] is pleased to introduce you the brand new gameplay trailer of the game [b]Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands[/b]. 

Developed by Swedish studio Toppluva, [b]Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands[/b] is a refreshing open-world ski and snowboard game in which players freely explore snowy slopes filled with hundreds of challenges to discover. 


Discover the specifics of the game in a brand new video: exploration, vast environments, challenges and tricks, local multiplayer or peace and quiet with the Zen Mode, all powder lovers will be happy! 

[previewyoutube=k8y96w2DD0E;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Game features[/b] :

- [b]An ode to exploration[/b]: Put on your skis or snowboard and explore 12 open-world winter sports resorts. Discover places you've never visited before in off-piste mode, from vast wild forests to the highest rocky peaks, from dizzying descents to isolated villages. 

- [b]Many challenges await you in the mountains[/b]: Take on Super G, Slopestyle, Big Air slaloms, find numerous collectibles, and much more! Hidden challenges and secret trails also await the most adventurous. 

- [b]Slide alone or with friends[/b]: Play local multiplayer with up to 4 players. Reach the finish line, knock your friends off their feet by hitting them or throwing snowballs at them. Explore the mountains on your own or with others!

- [b]Relax with Zen Mode[/b]: Zen Mode allows you to take a break and spend some quiet, relaxing time. All challenges, collectables and even NPCs are removed so you can enjoy the peace and quiet of the mountains with a glass of hot chocolate at hand!

[h3]CONNECT WITH US![/h3]

For the latest news and announcements, don't forget to visit our social channels.

notes.title: MIX PICKS 2021: MICROIDS UNVEILS TWO NEW INDIE GAMES
notes.notes:
Microids unveiled two new indie games during the Media Indie Exchange Picks 2021 showcase. Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands and Scrap Riders have joined its publishing label Microids Indie. Both games will launch on Nintendo Switch and PC in 2022

[b][u]About Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands[/u][/b]

Developed by Swedish studio Toppluva, Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands is a beautiful open-world skiing & snowboarding game where you get to explore entire mountains filled with hundreds of challenges to discover and compete in. So strap on your skis or board and prepare for a great adventure in the snowy mountains!

[previewyoutube=talyakohUsU;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]About Scrap Riders[/b][/u]

Scrap Riders is a pixel art adventure game set in a cyberpunk future, developed by the Spanish studio Games for Tutti. You play as Rast, a member of the outlaw bikers gang Scrap Riders, and make your way through the wastelands and a big metropolis controlled by corporations. Act as a smuggler with caustic humor to survive in this post-apocalyptic world.

[previewyoutube=twD8y6UnySw;full][/previewyoutube]
